csv_project_name: Transportation Impact Fee Nexus Study and Fee Program Update
csv_scope_of_work: The City of American Canyon is soliciting proposals from qualified firms or individuals ("Proposer") to prepare a comprehensive update to American Canyon s traffic / transportation impact fee program, including preparation of an impact fee nexus study, updated capital improvement project list, fee schedule, implementation recommendations, and related administrative procedures. The selected consultant will work closely with City staff, American Canyon Attorney, and other City consultants as needed. The consultant will be expected to prepare a complete nexus study and fee program suitable for public review, Planning Commission and/or City Council consideration, and future implementation.
